messages:
lina_sales: Quick: schedule POC handback for Nebula. Proposed Tue 11:00 PT. Need owners for: 1) hosted API key revocation, 2) dedicated pool dp-9 drain+terminate, 3) VPC peering + SG cleanup, 4) logs export/archive, 5) billing final statement. Can folks volunteer?

ben_ops: I can own dp-9 and VPC cleanup. Plan: set pool readonly, drain 10m, then terminate. Commands: 
```bash
rctl pool set dp-9 --mode readonly
rctl pool drain dp-9 --grace 600 --wait
rctl pool terminate dp-9 --force
```
I'll export flow logs before deletion.

sec_maya: I'll revoke hosted API keys and rotate any service principals. Will run revocation after logs are exported so audit is complete. Example call: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"nebula-poc","scope":"all"}'
```
I'll attach revocation audit.

sre_lee: I'll upload control-plane + inference logs to S3 (locked bucket) before any revocation: 
```bash
aws s3 sync /var/log/poc/nebula s3://nebula-poc-exports/1933007777 --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
Upload scheduled T-15.

billing_ana: Billing: on-demand GPU hours stop on termination. No reserved commit for this POC so charges stop after terminate; I'll produce a short usage statement post-termination.

ops-bot: Created ticket: POC-46211. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-teardown (automated).

lina_sales: Owners: ben_ops=pool+vpc, sec_maya=keys, sre_lee=logs, billing_ana=billing. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can make Tue 11:00 PT.

ben_ops: :white_check_mark: I'll be there and post timestamps.

sec_maya: :white_check_mark: Will schedule revoke at T+2 after upload.

sre_lee: :white_check_mark: Upload done T-15, will post link.

billing_ana: :white_check_mark: Will prepare usage note after termination.

lina_sales: Thanks team 97 please attach artifacts after completion: S3 export link, revocation audit, termination timestamp, and final billing note.
